# DNF — Did Not Field. Yet.

A school invitation list, checked October 22, 2026. No school or superintendent was contacted, and no interest response is inferred.

## What this list means

The schools below have no school-affiliated FTC or FRC team verified in our dated public-source review. DNF is an invitation to join the lineup. A new team, an unlisted affiliation, or participation in another robotics program may already exist.

Physical public, charter, and private campuses offering any of grades 9–12 within 60 straight-line miles of Citizens Square, downtown Fort Wayne, including Ohio and Michigan. School locations come from NCES and documented state/site supplements; directory years vary. Distance is tested before rounding. Older private-school records needing current campus confirmation are marked. Statewide virtual-school offices and adult-only diploma centers are excluded. Former teams and documented community-team connections are listed separately for follow-up.

The list describes school affiliations in FIRST Tech Challenge and FIRST Robotics Competition. It does not say a school has no STEM activities, no robotics of any kind, or no students on independent community teams. No inference is made about a superintendent’s support for robotics.

The campus universe contains 193 schools: 153 invitations, 19 with current/recent team affiliations, and 13 with former-team or community connections to confirm. 144 invitation rows have a named superintendent or school leader; the others retain an explicit unverified field.

## Geography and school coverage

Join NCES EDGE public2024–25 and private2023–24 school geocodes to CCD2024–25/PSS2023–24 characteristics by institutional ID; choose any offered grade9–12, not school title; haversine distance <=60 on unrounded double using Earth radius3958.7613mi. Bounding envelope -86.5,40.0,-83.8,42.1 fully contains the circle.

- Universe includes public district schools, public charters, ordinary private schools, and alternative/special/career/virtual records for review. No school has yet been assigned a team-presence status here.
- Ordinary-campus records can enter the school invitation list after team screen and leadercheck. Review classes need editorial decision before publishing. Virtual administrative addresses do not establish a local physical student campus.
- The CCD school map characteristics records current2024–25 status are Open/New; NCES is lagged and does not establish2026–27 operating status. Current state directory/site review is required for closures/renames and new openings.
- Private PSS is a survey universe; nonresponding/unlisted/new private schools can be absent. PSS2023–24 can include duplicate legacy IDs for a single campus; duplicate candidates are separately flagged.
- Any school offering grades9–12 is included; this does not require all four grades. Ungraded special schools require individual review and are not silently classified as high schools.
- Distance uses school location rather than school district centroid. Names/addresses are as reported to NCES, with current corrections recorded separately.

## Team screening

- Screened official FRC all-team rosters 2023–2027 for Indiana, Michigan and Ohio; checked local candidate team profiles, including registered teams without match statistics.
- Screened official FTC regional rosters 2024, 2025, 2026 for USIN, USMI and USOH and official school affiliations for nearby candidates. 2026 FTC means 2026–27 BIOBUZZ.
- Town internal points screened a 75-mile buffer; geography of schools is independently determined by the school-universe data. Profiles beyond 60 miles retained for boundary checking.
- Named positive school affiliations and documented community-team participants are retained; a nearby community team does not establish that every local school has a team.
- Only matching named school/campus is assigned affiliation. A district-level team, co-located virtual academy, sponsor, or career center does not automatically receive the school affiliation.
- The absence label describes this public-record screen and is not proof that a team, informal program or new registration does not exist. Robotics activities outside FIRST are outside this screen.

Current/recent team-affiliated schools are omitted from the invitation table even when a registration has no match statistics. The screening includes newer registrations and cross-border teams, and preserves named community participants and former teams below.

## Leadership

Names retain their published roles. A private-school principal or head is not relabeled superintendent. Current official district/school pages take precedence over older directories. Rows using the Indiana 2025–26 directory retain that year rather than claiming a verified 2026–27 appointment. The raw research files and offline join code are [in the repository](https://github.com/horner/refintery-rankings/tree/main/broadcast/data/dnf-research).

## The first step

Say you’re interested. [The REFINERY’s team-starting inquiry](https://refineryrobotics.org/get-involved/#start-or-host-a-team) and email drafts from the directory start a conversation; they do not enroll a school or commit it to a budget. [Published support](https://refineryrobotics.org/what-we-do/) includes program selection, organizational planning, mentor development, technical training, parts, tools and practice access. Launch support focuses on the 12-county Northeast Indiana region; border schools can ask about shared resources and connections.
